Late-delivery rate by category · distinct order membership
Route investigation · customer states with counts and review context
Seller review queue · ≥50 eligible orders and above peer late rate

metricExpressions.One Star Rate: IF(ISCROSSFILTERED(dim_seller[seller_id]) || ISCROSSFILTERED(dim_category[category]), CALCULATE(DIVIDE(CALCULATE([Reviewed Orders], fact_order[review_score] = 1), [Reviewed Orders]), KEEPFILTERS(TREATAS(VALUES(bridge_order_seller_category[order_id]), fact_order[order_id]))), DIVIDE(CALCULATE([Reviewed Orders], fact_order[review_score] = 1), [Reviewed Orders]))
metricExpressions.Five Star Rate: IF(ISCROSSFILTERED(dim_seller[seller_id]) || ISCROSSFILTERED(dim_category[category]), CALCULATE(DIVIDE(CALCULATE([Reviewed Orders], fact_order[review_score] = 5), [Reviewed Orders]), KEEPFILTERS(TREATAS(VALUES(bridge_order_seller_category[order_id]), fact_order[order_id]))), DIVIDE(CALCULATE([Reviewed Orders], fact_order[review_score] = 5), [Reviewed Orders]))
metricExpressions.Seller Priority Flag: IF([Eligible Deliveries] >= 50 && [Late Delivery Rate] > [Seller Baseline Late Rate], 1, BLANK())
metricExpressions.Common Duration Orders: CALCULATE([Total Orders], FILTER(fact_order, NOT ISBLANK(fact_order[processing_days]) && NOT ISBLANK(fact_order[shipping_days])))
metricExpressions.Common Processing Days: CALCULATE([Average Processing Days], FILTER(fact_order, NOT ISBLANK(fact_order[processing_days]) && NOT ISBLANK(fact_order[shipping_days])))
metricExpressions.Common Shipping Days: CALCULATE([Average Shipping Days], FILTER(fact_order, NOT ISBLANK(fact_order[processing_days]) && NOT ISBLANK(fact_order[shipping_days])))
metricExpressions.Context Insight: IF([Eligible Deliveries] = 0, "No eligible deliveries in the current selection", FORMAT([Late Deliveries], "#,0") & " late deliveries; late-order reviews average " & FORMAT([Late Review Score], "0.00") & " vs " & FORMAT([On Time Review Score], "0.00") & " on time. Investigate routes and handoff stages; association is not causation.")
metricExpressions.Period Coverage: FORMAT(MIN(fact_order[purchase_date]), "dd MMM yyyy") & " – " & FORMAT(MAX(fact_order[purchase_date]), "dd MMM yyyy")
